Definition: ; strengthened for a primary τίω (which is only used as an alternate in certain tenses); to pay a price, i.e. as a penalty:--be punished with.
BiblicalUsage: The word means to pay a price, and its one New Testament use is a sentence. Those who do not know God and do not obey the gospel shall pay it with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the verse leaves no room for a light view of rejection: the price is paid, and it is paid forever.
